title: Spoken correction, identity and ongoing constraint
origin: New teaching pair; not the historical JSON template or an experimental outcome.
source: Turn left, sorry, right and go through the blue door into the lounge. Cross the lounge with the sofa on your left and wait by the window.

subtasks: Turn right and go through the blue door into the lounge.
Cross the lounge with the sofa on your left and wait by the window.
Turn left, then right and go through the blue door into the lounge.
Cross the lounge with the sofa on your left and wait by the window.

execution_or_focus_difference: The superseded action is now executed. Ordinary later turns, by contrast, must not be silently removed.
alternative_or_limit: Cross the lounge already names the region; a redundant recap is unnecessary.
